item.title: 2.0.0-beta-5
item.description:
# Doppel 2.0.0-beta-5
- Fixes clone rebuilds on ChatGPT 26.1013. That build changed how it hands deep links to the app, so Doppel could not patch the OAuth callback routing and every instance failed to start with "Patching the instance OAuth callback routing failed".
Includes [PR #56](https://github.com/thomast8/doppel/pull/56).
This remains a beta. Remote Access requires the Mac to stay awake and logged in. Menu-click and physical-keypad reconnection QA remain incomplete, and macOS 14 execution, logout/login recovery, and network-loss recovery still need broader testing.

item.title: 2.0.0-beta-4
item.description:
# Doppel 2.0.0-beta-4
- Failed actions now show short messages instead of command-output dumps. For example, a disk-full extraction error tells you to free space and retry. Full CLI diagnostics are saved locally with owner-only permissions. - Assign Creator Micro to a managed instance from Doppel’s menu. Assignment changes automatically restart affected running instances; selecting the current owner leaves it alone. Save unfinished drafts before changing the assignment. Official ChatGPT also uses the keypad while it runs. - Release Assignment can clear an old assignment after its instance was removed.
Includes [PR #55](https://github.com/thomast8/doppel/pull/55) and [PR #54](https://github.com/thomast8/doppel/pull/54).
This remains a beta. Remote Access requires the Mac to stay awake and logged in. Menu-click and physical-keypad reconnection QA remain incomplete, and macOS 14 execution, logout/login recovery, and network-loss recovery still need broader testing.

item.title: 2.0.0-beta-3
item.description:
# Doppel 2.0.0-beta-3
- Disabling Remote Access now revokes the phone key before it closes open sessions, so a phone that connects at that moment can't slip in and keep running. - You can switch a disabled profile to a different ChatGPT account, and Enable works again after Disable without signing in a second time. Doppel still checks that the live account matches the one you confirm before turning access on. - Replace Key and Update Runtime now appear while a profile is disabled, which is when they can run. - The menu notices engine changes made from the `doppel` command line within a few minutes. Running a profile on official ChatGPT now lives under each instance's Fallback Engine submenu, since clones are the normal engine. - Beta builds point at the beta update feed by default, so a beta install keeps receiving later betas.
This is a beta. Remote Access limits from beta-2 still apply: the Mac must stay awake and logged in, and macOS 14 execution, logout/login recovery and network-loss recovery still need broader testing.
